about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh calendar captures for Tenshu Calendar (`captured`, from the UI test in `uiTests`). The fixture is generated for the run's day (store/fixtures/calendar/generate_calendar.py) — one .ics file per calendar — and goes in through Calendar's own .ics import on a data-only seed launch (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §3b). Adding a capture means adding it here. Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-month.shows: The month grid with a coloured dot per busy day, and today's events beneath it

02-agenda.shows: The agenda: the coming days' events across five calendars, recurring ones marked

03-event.shows: An event's detail: when, where and its notes

04-new-event.shows: Creating an event: title, location, calendar, time, repeat and reminders

05-calendars.shows: The calendars list: Personal, Work, Family, Fitness and Travel in their colours

06-edit-calendar.shows: A calendar's sheet: its name, the lock-screen privacy switch and the colour palette

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, light only, keyed android/phone/<lang>/NN-screen. Same names as iOS for the same screen; a name new to Android must also be listed in captured or planned above, so a number never means two screens.

01-month.shows: The month grid with a coloured dot per busy day, and today's events beneath it

02-agenda.shows: The agenda: the coming days' events across five calendars

03-event.shows: An event opened: its time, repeat, reminder, calendar, location and notes (Android opens events in the editor)

04-new-event.shows: Creating an event: title, date and time, repeat, reminders, calendar and location

05-calendars.shows: The calendars list: Personal, Work, Family, Fitness and Travel in their colours

06-edit-calendar.shows: Work's sheet: its name, the colour palette and the lock-screen privacy switch

07-week.shows: The week as a time grid, events in their calendars' colours
The week as a time grid

08-day.shows: One day as a time grid
